summary.text: Justine Caldwell is a Democratic state representative who has represented District 30 in the Rhode Island House of Representatives since January 1, 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: In the 2021-2022 legislative session Caldwell was second vice chair of the Corporations Committee and was also assigned to the House Education Committee, the House Judiciary Committee and the Small Business Committee.
